kernel: d345_event_book.simulate_event via run_d359.run_short (cap 10, no slot cap, hedged by the floored market)
sign: pnl > 0: the SHORT made money. pnl = -sum over held bars of (v - m); the entry bar on ocT - m_f_oc, later bars on r1T - m_f
row: one raw T2 candidate (pct_gap >= 98 & pct_rv >= 90 on day g, eligible at g+1); 24,736 events + 14 excluded ([XD])
runs: ungated / G2 / G1: the same kernel on the whole trigger, on the G2-gated arm, on the G1-gated arm; skips differ because the books differ

measured_at.g: the gap day, known at its close
measured_at.t-1: information to the close of bar_entry - 1 (the kernel's lag)
measured_at.path: an OUTCOME from the entry open

floats: written with Python repr (round-trip exact); '' is NaN; flags are 0/1

columns.definition: ticker (P['symbols'][row])
the panel column index of the name
the gap day's bar index g
the gap day (YYYY-MM-DD)
the event / entry bar index t = g + 1; the fill is the OPEN of this bar (D340)
the entry bar's date
calendar year of bar_entry
1 if bar_entry < T // 2 else 2 (the runners' era split; T = 4187)
1 if year in the floored market's down-years (2015, 2018, 2022)
weekday of date_entry, 0 = Monday .. 4 = Friday

'' for a T2 event; 'xd' / 'v0' / 'nf' (joined by +) for a raw candidate D360 excluded on day g: ex-distribution >= 1% of the prior close / zero volume / no prior close. Excluded rows are in no arm and no run
1 if G1 is on at bar_entry: the floored market's trailing 63-bar COMPOUNDED return over bars t-63..t-1 < 0 (run_d361.gate_pack); 0 where off or undefined
1 if bar_entry >= m_start + 63 (the window fits)
prod(1 + m_f[t-63..t-1]) - 1, the G1 level; NaN where undefined
index (0-based, in time order) of the G1 on-episode containing bar_entry; -1 if off
bars in that episode (0 if off). NOTE the episode's END is hindsight; its start and id are not
1 if G2 is on at bar_entry: index[t-1] < mean(index[t-200..t-1]) with index = cumprod(1 + m_f) from m_start; the cell's gate
1 if bar_entry >= m_start + 200
index[t-1] / mean(index[t-200..t-1]) - 1, the G2 level; NaN where undefined
index of the G2 on-episode containing bar_entry; -1 if off
bars in that G2 episode (0 if off); the episode's end is hindsight
prod(1 + m_f[t-20..t-1]) - 1: the floored market's trailing 20-bar compounded return (fraction); NaN where the window precedes m_start
sd (ddof = 1) of m_f over bars t-20..t-1, in bp
OPEN[g] / CLOSE[g-1] - 1 (split-adjusted frame, the fixture's; run_d360.signal_grids)
average-rank percentile of gap among the day-g cross-section cs (eligible at g+1, finite gap and rv); the trigger needs >= 98
VOL[g] / median(VOL[g-21..g-1]) (run_d360.relative_volume); NaN unless all 21 prior volumes are finite and the median > 0
percentile of rv on the same cross-section; the trigger needs >= 90
100 - pct_gap, the score the kernel orders entries by at bar_entry (highest first, ties by row descending)
r1T[g]: the name's close(g-1) -> close(g) simple TOTAL return (fraction)
ocT[g]: the name's open(g) -> close(g) return on the gap day (fraction): did the gap extend or fade intraday
shares traded on day g (the fixture's volume)
CLOSE[g] x VOL[g] (split-adjusted close x volume, DV's construction), dollars
(high - low) / open on day g, from the raw fixture's bars (streamed; open/close asserted equal to the grids)
(close - low) / (high - low) on day g; NaN when high == low
the AS-TRADED close on day g (RAW_CLOSE = CLOSE x the split factor)
CLOSE[g], split-adjusted
the as-traded open of bar_entry (the fill price): OPEN[t] x RAW[t]
OPEN[t], split-adjusted
P['DV'][t]: trailing 63-bar mean of CLOSE x VOL, lagged one bar (dollars)
share (x100) of eligible names at bar_entry with finite DV whose DV[t] is strictly below this name's -- the record's four_groups convention (P['DV'] at e0 among elig[e0]); DV is itself lagged

1 if the name is inside a D331 deal-filing (F0) exclusion window at t-1 (P['excl'][row, t-1]); the HTB rule's first leg
